|game_text='''Agendas''': order. May be targeted by [[Might Of The Republic]]. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 and gain [Republic] here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with 'Valorum', 'governor' or 'political' in lore.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of the AI printing [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (AI)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text on the AI card, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-03-Supreme_Chancellor_Valorum_AI-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee AI card image ([[:File:VB8-L-supremechancellorvalorumai-pre.gif]]) shows the original text (see [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (AI)]]).
* '''Original (AI)''' ([[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (AI)]]): the Players Committee AI card image ([[:File:VB8-L-supremechancellorvalorumai-pre.gif]], undated) prints the release-sheet text of [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V)]]: “Agenda: order. May be targeted by Might Of The Republic. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 (and gain [Republic]) here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with "governor," "political," or "Valorum" in lore.” The Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012) has no AI slip; its slip of the base card prints the same text.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 5, slip 30 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) has no AI slip either.
* '''PC-E1 (AI)''' (this page): the PC website card list lists the AI card (its own row, card image supremechancellorvalorumai.gif) with the same rewording as the base card's PC-E1 ([[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (Errata)]]), shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013: “Agendas” for “Agenda”, no parentheses (“deploy -1 and gain [Republic] here”) and “Valorum” moved first. PC-E1 text: “Agendas: order. May be targeted by Might Of The Republic. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 and gain [Republic] here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with 'Valorum', 'governor' or 'political' in lore.”<ref name="cl-1281_30ai">Players Committee website card list, row of the AI card image supremechancellorvalorumai.gif: VBlock8Type as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (the ▲ printed as “/\”), [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11] (the ▲ written out as “take into hand … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, notation only); VMasterType as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
